stem.en: The fuel a vehicle uses on a trip depends on which of these?

feedback.en: On a round trip the displacement is zero, but the vehicle still uses fuel.
Right. The engine works for every metre driven, even on a round trip.
A longer drive uses more fuel, so the fuel used does depend on how far the vehicle goes.

explanation.en: The engine works for every metre the vehicle moves, in either direction. So the fuel used depends on the total distance travelled, not on the displacement.

hints.en: What is the displacement of a round trip? Does that trip use fuel?
